args.query:
SELECT h.category, COUNT(*) AS completions
FROM fct_value_moments v
JOIN dim_habit h USING (habit_id)
JOIN dim_users u USING (user_id)
WHERE u.is_internal = FALSE
  AND v.completed_date BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2026-07-12'
GROUP BY h.category

Note: acquisition_spend (excluding 'partnerships') would give £53,042 / 1,214 = £43.68 per signup; the two metrics differ because acquisition_spend excludes spend on the 'partnerships' channel.
